title: Success probability of a padded graph walk
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $r$ be a symmetric relation on the vertices $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $s,t$ be vertices such that $t$ is reachable from $s$ by a finite sequence of $r$-steps. Set $D=2^{\operatorname{size}(n)}$, where $\operatorname{size}(n)$ is the binary size of $n$, and fix a bijection from the binary words of length $\operatorname{size}(n)$ to the $D$ edge slots. Choose uniformly a binary word of length $100n^4\operatorname{size}(n)$, decode it into $100n^4$ edge slots using this bijection, and walk from $s$ in the padded undirected regular multigraph determined by $r$, accepting if the visited vertices include $t$. The probability of acceptance is at least $3/4$.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ is reachable from $s$ by finitely many $r$-steps
There is a bijection from length-$\operatorname{size}(n)$ binary words to the $2^{\operatorname{size}(n)}$ edge slots
